subject: math
l2: 一元微分学（求导与作图）
question: 设 $y = f(x)$ 由 $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = t^2 + 2t \\ t^2 - y + a\sin y = 1 \end{array} \right.$ 确定. 若 $y(0) = b$ ，求 $\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}x^2}\bigg|_{t=0}$ .
answer: \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\dot {y}}{\dot {x}} = \frac {t}{(t + 1) (1 - a \cos y)}, \left. \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} \right| _ {t = 0} = 0,

steps.text:
分析 这是参数方程中含隐函数的情况. 计算 $\dot{y}$ 时需对第二个等式按隐函数方程求导, 再用公式 $\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = \frac{\dot{y}}{\dot{x}}$ ; 计算 $\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}x^2}\right|_{t=0}$ 时, 可先求出二阶导数的一般表达式, 再代入 $t=0$ , 也可由二阶导数的定义求

极限 $\lim_{t\to 0}\frac{\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{t = 0}}{x(t) - x(0)}.$
方程组两边对 $t$ 求导，得

\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \dot {x} = 2 t + 2 \\ 2 t - \dot {y} + a \cos y \cdot \dot {y} = 0 \end{array} \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{array}{l} \dot {x} = 2 (t + 1) \\ \dot {y} = \frac {2 t}{1 - a \cos y}, \end{array} \right. \right.
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\dot {y}}{\dot {x}} = \frac {t}{(t + 1) (1 - a \cos y)}, \left. \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} \right| _ {t = 0} = 0,

\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}\right) _ {t} ^ {\prime}}{\dot {x}} = \frac {\frac {(1 - a \cos y) - a t (t + 1) \sin y \cdot \dot {y}}{(t + 1) ^ {2} (1 - a \cos y) ^ {2}}}{2 (t + 1)}.

solution.final_answer: \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\dot {y}}{\dot {x}} = \frac {t}{(t + 1) (1 - a \cos y)}, \left. \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} \right| _ {t = 0} = 0,

cdps.expected: 按函数给出形式选对应法则；二阶导注意对自变量链式求导并回代。
